summary.text: Joe Walker is the Republican candidate for the Pennsylvania House of Representatives, District 166, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Judy Trombetta.
An insurance broker, he said in a Ballotpedia survey that he is running to apply real-world solutions to property taxes, healthcare costs, school choice and public safety.

paragraphs.text: Joe Walker graduated from Archbishop John Carroll High School and earned a bachelor's degree from Widener University in 1997.
His listed profession is insurance broker, and in his 2026 Ballotpedia survey response he cited two decades as an insurance broker and coach.
He advanced from the Republican primary on May 19, 2026.
Walker said he would pursue tax abatements and residency-based ceilings to address property tax increases in Haverford and Marple.
He also said he would work to expand school choice and Educational Improvement Tax Credit programs and to increase healthcare price transparency and competition.
